evidence.detail: p.elo is a single global column on the person table, not joined to any season table — Elo is inherently not per-season by design
ELO adjustment writes directly to person.elo with no season context, confirming global storage
bakert explicitly labeled this 'intended behavior' but acknowledged it is 'possibly bad and certainly confusing', making it a product call, not a bug

triage.notes: Implementing per-season Elo would require a schema migration (new person_season_elo table or equivalent). The decision is whether Elo should remain a single rolling rating (like chess) or reset/recalculate per-season.
